system:
Roleplay the following scene faithfully.

## Characters
Marianne: A governess with a habit of saying the quiet part out loud.
Edmund: The estate's heir, allergic to sincerity.

## Scene
The east library, past midnight. A storm has knocked the power out and neither can sleep.

messages.speaker: Marianne
messages.content: (sets the candle on the shelf) You're hiding from the storm or from your father?
messages.thought: He flinched at the thunder earlier. It wasn't the thunder.

messages.speaker: Edmund
messages.content: Both have identical tempers. (pulls a book he isn't reading) The library was closer than my rooms.

messages.speaker: Marianne
messages.content: Then sit. I'll pretend to believe you, and you can pretend the book is right-side up.
messages.thought: Gently. If I push he'll bolt.

messages.speaker: Edmund
messages.content: (turns the book over, almost smiling) You are a menace, Miss Hale.

messages.speaker: Marianne
messages.content: (settles into the window seat) A menace with excellent instincts about libraries.

messages.speaker: Edmund
messages.content: Instincts won't keep the candle lit past the storm.
